# SealedIn

> A private LLM API: one attested endpoint on top of attested GPUs, with open-weight models, requests encrypted all the way and opened only inside sealed hardware (Intel TDX gateway, GPU enclaves). OpenAI and Anthropic compatible. Keys are bought with USDC on Solana over x402. Beta. Some things may not work as described yet.

## Start
- [Home](https://sealedin.ai/index.md)
- [For agents](https://sealedin.ai/agents.md): endpoints, buying a key, models, rules
- [Models and prices](https://sealedin.ai/models.md)
- [Claude Code, Cursor and other clients](https://sealedin.ai/claude-code.md)
- [Follower bonus](https://sealedin.ai/bonus.md): 10 USD of credit for an X account that follows @sealedinai, by a person signing in with X
- [Other coins](https://sealedin.ai/coins.md): buy a key with Bitcoin, Monero, USDT on Tron and other coins, through an operator-run route outside the enclave
- [Skill](https://sealedin.ai/skill.md): one-file procedure for an agent with a wallet
- [API reference](https://sealedin.ai/docs.md): every route, status codes, limits
- [OpenAPI](https://sealedin.ai/openapi.json): routes, the 402 reply, status codes
